newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Elan says Panoz to retire as chairman.
newsitem.headline: Elan says Panoz to retire as chairman.

text.p: Elan Corp said on Monday that Donald Panoz would retire as chairman of the board on December 31, 1996 and would be replaced by president and chief executive officer Donal Geaney.
Panoz will become Chairman Emeritus of Elan and will also remain a non-executive director of the company, Elan said in a statement.
Panoz founded Elan in 1969 and retired as chief executive officer in December 1994.
Geaney joined Elan as executive vice president in 1987 and became chief executive officer in January 1995.

"We have achieved an orderly and successful transition to our new management team and I am pleased as both a shareholder and founder of the company to entrust Elan to the very capable leadership of Donal Geaney," Panoz said in a statement.
"I am confident that Elan will continue to flourish and I look forward to its continuing success," he said.
